recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. No core follow-up is needed; if the bodySite extension name ever regresses in publication, fix it in the FHIR Extension Pack source.
issue_request: FHIR-33153 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction requesting StructureDefinition/bodySite to use the machine-readable name BodyStructureReference instead of BodyStructure Reference to avoid FSH/SUSHI parsing problems.
initial_application: The old R4-era core general extensions spreadsheet had a bodySite row with BodyStructure Reference. FHIR-I minutes recorded the correction as will-fix, but no explicit core commit tagged FHIR-33153 was found. During R5 cleanup the extension was removed from core, and the FHIR Extension Pack initial bodySite source already has name BodyStructureReference.
additional_context: Current core source still references the canonical extension URL from active resource definitions but no longer contains the bodySite extension definition in its active extension spreadsheets. Later extension-pack commits for FHIR-42935 and FHIR-50043 changed bodySite contexts, confirming the external repository is the maintained source. Community searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source hunk is appropriate because the current authoritative source is outside this checkout and already implements the requested name.
